description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Prince George is a budget chain motel located on Commercial Crescent in Prince George, a major service hub on cycling routes through central British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham family of brands, it offers standard motel amenities in a city that serves as a key overnight stop for cyclists traveling the Yellowhead corridor or exploring the region. The property is flagged as wheelchair accessible in OSM.
